real_world_example:
The Battle of Panipat (1556) is an example where the Marathas' naval power played a crucial role in defeating their rival, the Mughal Empire.
The Marathas' navy successfully blockaded the Mughal ports and supply lines, weakening the empire's ability to respond to the invasion. This strategic victory cemented the Maratha Empire's position as a dominant force in Indian politics.
